description: K28-aftermath Leak A regression. Catching an exception carrying a DV::Object attribute with a non-empty Array<DiagnosticEntry> and calling .entries() on the cloned DV must leave no leaks. Exercises both rvalue receiver (e.attrs["fields"].entries()) and bound receiver (val dv = e.attrs["fields"]; dv.entries()). Heap-allocated keys force drift_string_release to observe any missing drop. Fails under DRIFT_MEMCHECK=1 pre-fix; exit_code=0 passes.
